topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe my college application essay was chosen as an example. It's a bit overwhelming, to be honest. I always thought my writing could use some polish, and now it’s out there for everyone to see. I hope it serves as a useful guide. I remember spending countless hours on it, trying to get every word just right. It’s strange to think that others might now be reading it not just for the story, but to see what they should or shouldn't do in their own essays. I wish I had known it would be so visible; I might have asked for more feedback before submitting it. Oh well, I guess it’s a learning experience for all of us.
